subject.title: feat(gateway): include produced messageId on chat final/aborted events

question: Should final and aborted gateway chat events expose the persisted assistant transcript ID as the public run-output identity contract?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but clients will rely on this field across contentless, tool-only, retry, and abort outcomes; maintainers must confirm those public semantics.

options.title: Adopt persisted assistant ID
options.body: Approve the optional field after persistence-backed coverage and live external-client proof establish its terminal-run semantics.

options.title: Design a richer output reference
options.body: Pause this field and define a run-output envelope that can also represent tool-only or side-effect-only outcomes.

recommendation.title: Adopt persisted assistant ID
recommendation.body: Approve the optional field after persistence-backed coverage and live external-client proof establish its terminal-run semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current and historical ownership across gateway chat events, transcript projection, and run identity.
